coordinateSystem: Source image pixels x/y, not world x/z. Point anchors use pixel; surfaces use outer.

conversion.physicalDimensions: Metres, to be multiplied by projection.SCALE after the final root-owned road registration.
conversion.outer: pixel_to_world(pixel, sourceHeightMeters); never treat a roof outline as ground-plane pixels.
conversion.point: pixel_to_world(pixel, sourceHeightMeters). A support attachment remains vertically above the same XZ footing.
conversion.ringAngle: Convert horizontalDiameterPixels endpoints at ring sourceHeightMeters; Three yaw = -atan2(dz,dx).
conversion.lampArm: Convert headPixel and headTipPixel at sourceHeightMeters; use their world-XZ difference.
conversion.precision: Manually identified visible source edges. Heights and obscured anchors are reconstruction estimates.
